objects.name: Analytic 2183
objects.description: Use an OT-capable protocol decoder to monitor SNMP requests/responses and identify access to vendor-internal or undocumented OIDs from sources outside the approved NMS inventory, especially SET operations or unusual walks against control-network infrastructure. This is network-protocol observation, not OS API execution; require decoded SNMP transaction content or equivalent packet inspection.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: otids:ProtocolDecoder
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: SNMP request/response decoder: OID, operation type, source/destination; flag access to undocumented/vendor-internal OIDs from non-approved NMS sources
